segment.text: We collect personal data that you provide directly to us. For example, we collect information directly from you when you create an account, add information to your profile, fill out a form, make a purchase or subscribe to certain iFIT Services, sign up for our marketing communications, participate in a survey, contest, sweepstakes, or promotion we offer, provide us with feedback, request customer support, or otherwise communicate with us. The types of data we collect include your first and last name, username and password, birth month and year, email address, postal address, and phone number. We also collect certain fitness data that you choose to provide in connection with your use of the iFIT Services, such as sex, height, current weight and goal weight, workout and fitness goals and preferences (like the time of day you like to exercise and the types of workouts you prefer), fitness level, injury and condition information to inform workout recommendations, and other interests and preferences that you choose to provide. We collect information directly from you when you interact with our AI-powered offerings, including our Tailor app that offers AI-powered personal training or our SMS-based AI coach. When you use these services, we collect content you provide including your prompts, questions, responses, and other content you provide or upload to the iFIT Services. If you make a purchase from us, we work with a third-party payment processor to collect and process your payment information. We collect other information that you may provide to us, such as when you provide user feedback.

segment.text: We automatically collect certain data about your interactions with us and the iFIT Services, including: Activity Data: We collect information about your activity on the iFIT Services, such as workouts and activities completed, calories burned, challenges you participate in, and content you engage with. If you connect a heart rate monitor to the iFIT Services, we will also receive information about your heart rate during workouts. Transactional Data: When you make, exchange, or return a purchase, we collect information about the transaction, such as product details, purchase price, and the date and location of the transaction. Device and Usage Data: We collect data about how you access the iFIT Services, including data about the device and network you use, such as your hardware or machine model, operating system version, mobile network, IP address, unique device identifiers, browser type, time zone, and app version. We also collect information about your activity on the iFIT Services, such as access times, pages viewed, and links clicked. Communications with Us: If you contact customer service through our chat feature or by phone, or if you participate in a video consult with our sales team, we may monitor and retain those interactions, including for training purposes. Data Collected by Cookies and Similar Tracking Technologies: We use tracking technologies, such as cookies, pixels, SDKs, and APIs to collect information about your interactions with the iFIT Services and our communications with you. These technologies help us improve the iFIT Services, personalize your experience, count visits, understand if you opened or acted upon an email we sent, and analyze trends. For more information about the cookies and other tracking technologies we use, and the choices available to you see the Targeted Advertising and Analytics and Your Choices sections below.

segment.text: If you use our AI-powered personal training app, Tailor, you may choose to enable the voice feature to provide prompts and information using your device's microphone. You will be given the choice to allow Tailor to access your device microphone when you onboard with Tailor. You can activate the microphone during subsequent sessions by pressing the Tailor button within the app, and you can stop the recording by pressing the Tailor button again or navigating away from the Tailor app. When you activate the microphone, Tailor records and sends audio to the cloud. Our service providers receive the audio data we collect through Tailor to transcribe the audio into text. The audio data is immediately deleted after it has been transcribed. In addition, neither iFIT, nor our service providers use the audio to identify you. We and our service providers use the transcriptions of your interactions with Tailor for the purposes explained below, including to provide and personalize the iFIT Services to you and improve Tailor and our other products and services and build new ones. We retain the transcriptions of audio data for these purposes. You can choose not to use the microphone or delete your account at any time.
